paper_title: Searching for scalar field dark matter with LIGO
notes: Paper sets 95% CL upper limits on scalar DM couplings 1/Lambda_gamma (d_e, ScalarPhoton) and 1/Lambda_e (d_me, ScalarElectron) using LIGO O3 data, frequency band 10-180 Hz (~5e-14 to 1e-12 eV), competitive up to 5000 Hz. Local DM density rho_CDM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed. No numerical tables given; results shown only as smoothed curves in Fig. 3 (de in panel b, dme in panel a), so no reliable data points extractable. Coupling type ambiguous between ScalarPhoton and ScalarElectron since analysis cannot distinguish Lambda_gamma vs Lambda_e. | Vision: Constraint from panel b) showing photon coupling Λ_γ^-1 / d_e for scalar field DM from LIGO O3. The blue LIGO exclusion region spans roughly 4e-14 to 1e-10 eV. Lower boundary traced; the minimum coupling sensitivity is around d_e ~ 1.3e-20. Note y-axis on left is Λ_γ^-1 in GeV^-1; d_e values estimated from right axis. | Calibration: Spot-check calibration: verify/stage2 ratio=0.1x
